bounded_claim: This successor test concerns only semantic divergence within supplied CONFLICT observations. It does not establish observation authenticity, resolver correctness, distributed consensus, jurisdictional freshness, external provenance, or production deployment behavior.
governing_question: Does the successor AuthorityResolution representation reject a CONFLICT whose supplied observations are all identical, while preserving valid CONFLICT representation when at least two observations materially differ?
negative_control: Two identical AuthorityState observations supplied as CONFLICT must be rejected.
planned_control: CONFLICT must retain the existing minimum observation count of two and must contain at least one observation different from another supplied observation.
positive_controls: Two materially different AuthorityState observations remain valid as CONFLICT.
Existing ESTABLISHED observation-presence control remains preserved.
Existing ESTABLISHED observation-coherence control remains preserved.
title: Homogeneous Conflict Rejection
